summary: LAUNCH currently advertises Cohort 37, September 2026, a 14-week program and $125K investment. Its application banner remains open, but that cohort has already started and no future cutoff or next batch dates are published.

sources.title: LAUNCH Accelerator

notes: The live HTML did not expose text to the browser reader; the official indexed page supplied the details. Do not treat an undated Apply Now banner as evidence of a future cohort.
